data.title: 焰影苇草 · 暮色海角悬崖捧起生命微光的温存守望
data.action: 伫立在浪花拍打的悬崖海角边缘，双手拢在胸前掌心浮起一缕温和的生命火苗，转头温婉注视身侧同伴
data.location: 直面浩瀚大洋的苍茫红岩悬崖绝壁与夕照海岸
data.lighting: 海天尽头被落日烧成一片深红与金紫交织的晚霞，掌心跳跃的赤金生命火焰照亮温润清丽的面庞
data.mood: 慈悲温婉、生命重生的希望与永不熄灭的深情守候
data.description: 晚风将大海的咸涩与晚霞的热度一同送上海崖。苇草的赤红长发在风中如流火飞舞，龙尾上的金环在夕阳下泛起古朴光芒。她双手捧起一朵不伤人的温柔小火苗，将微光递向你，澄净的眼眸中满是释怀与眷恋——「博士，这里的海浪……能洗去生命消逝的灰烬。掌心的火不再带来毁灭，它现在很暖。如果有风吹来，就靠在我身边吧。」
data.promptProse: Reed stands near the edge of a red-rock coastal cliff at dusk in a smoldering crimson-and-gold high-neck cutout monokini with ornate gold rings along her tail. Cupping a gentle golden flame between both palms as sea wind lifts her blonde hair, she turns toward the viewer with a serene, tender smile against the burning sunset sky.
data.animaCaption: Standing near the windswept sea cliff edge in a crimson-and-gold cutout monokini, she cups a gentle golden flame between her palms and turns back toward the viewer with a serene smile. Deep sunset light over the ocean blends with the warm spark in her hands.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a crimson-and-gold gradient high-neck monokini with flame-shaped waist cutouts and ornate gold rings clasping her dragon tail.
